versions.changelog:
Initial release introducing autonomous scientific discovery for open-ended problems.

- Enables agent-driven hypothesis generation, experiment design, evidence scoring, and iterative convergence.
- Runs locally with zero dependencies; includes built-in selftest and modular observer integration.
- Supports search-space sampling, evidence accumulation, and adaptive hypothesis pruning/regeneration.
- Integrates auto-learning: records operational history and user preferences to optimize output quality and efficiency over time.
- Includes utility scripts for tracking errors, preferences, insights, and generating improvement suggestions automatically.
